goal: Allow nodes to relay and accept Taproot transactions that include annexes
Currently non-standard policy prevents standard mempool relay of transactions using annexes
reviewability: Nothing is known that would invalidate review
agreement: Approval without stated reasons after earlier objections were resolved (petertodd, Rob1Ham)
Verified implementation and mutation test coverage (AndreaDiazCorreia)
Asked why the previous 256-byte annex size limit was removed (AndreaDiazCorreia)
Asked whether node operators should have a setting to disable annex relay (AndreaDiazCorreia)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because it expands standard mempool relay to permit Taproot annexes
Unblocks transactions relying on annexes for arbitrary data availability or marker opt-in
